svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-07-31
svg.desc: Graph documentation and Electrocute lifecycle tests.
svg.text: 2026-07-31 - Graph documentation and Electrocute lifecycle
main | 2 commits: 89a5449, c67ff78
Daily job
Document the migrated ability system and test the lifecycle boundaries that Electrocute depends on.
Beam lifecycle/XML, combat-avatar and data-ability fixtures, graph runtime tests, GAS docs, and migration TODOs changed.
BEFORE
Migration status was implicit
Beam lifecycle expectations were scattered.
Graph fixtures did not cover key boundaries.
Docs did not clearly separate migrated
and pending ability work.
AFTER
Lifecycle and migration status are inspectable
Electrocute XML/node behavior and target lifecycle are hardened.
Combat-avatar and data-ability fixtures exercise sequence, montage, and beam boundaries.
GAS ability documentation explains the data-driven execution model.
Migration TODO tracking shows what is migrated versus pending.
Guard: lifecycle tests make cleanup and target handling part of the contract.
Important guard
Use test fixtures to understand execution
boundaries; use docs/TODOs to understand
migration status.
Validation / newcomer path
Start at GAS ability docs, then fixtures,
then Electrocute lifecycle code and TODOs.
The graph is both runtime and testable contract.
